prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1020; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained serious injuries as a result of this collision and is now seeking compensation for medical expenses, lost income, and pain and suffering.

Please be advised that this letter constitutes formal notice of representation. Effective immediately, all communication regarding this claim, including requests for statements, settlement discussions, and correspondence, must be directed exclusively to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly.

We request that you provide a certified copy of the policy declarations page and confirmation of the applicable bodily injury and property damage liability limits for the insured driver's policy at the time of the accident.

We further request that your insured, and your company, preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, witness statements, claim file materials, repair estimates, and any dashcam or telematics footage. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained.
